'''Arno Gallorr''' was a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who lived in the town of [[Corestrike]] on [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. He was the son of [[Mortris Gallorr]], and was married to [[Serise Gallorr|Serise]] with whom he had a child, [[Selmar Gallorr|Selmar]]. Alongside his father, Gallorr was a member of the town's [[Magistrate Council]], although he had been threatened into abstaining from all votes by the local criminal, [[Themog]].<ref name="HNNA" />
